papers.title_en: Selection Policies for Equal-Byte Mixed-Precision Quantization of Small Language Models
papers.authors: Smit Anand
papers.evidence: 等字节预算下小语言模型的混合精度量化
papers.tldr: 在参数字节预算不变的前提下，改变哪些矩阵分配2/4/8比特，能否提升小语言模型？作者在同一遗传算法中比较二元锦标赛与Alternis式父代选择，并以随机修复分配作基线，统一使用MLX仿射量化器与字节上限。Qwen3-1.7B上500个分配、10组配对种子显示，锦标赛使留出NLL在AG News降0.0616、IMDb降0.0152且10个种子全部改善，随机基线则退回均匀4比特。贡献是给出选择策略有效性的受控证据。
papers.abstract_en: Can changing which matrices receive 2, 4, or 8 bits improve a small language model without increasing its parameter storage? I compare two parent-selection rules in the same genetic algorithm: a binary-tournament variant and an Alternis-inspired rule. A separate baseline samples repaired random allocations without crossover or mutation. All three use the same MLX affine quantizer, byte ceiling, initialization and candidate allowance within each study. An exploratory study on Qwen3.5-2B evaluates 90 allocations per run. The main study on Qwen3-1.7B evaluates 500 distinct allocations per run over 10 paired seeds. Against uniform four-bit, tournament reduces held-out next-token negative log-likelihood (NLL) by 0.0616 on AG News and 0.0152 on IMDb on average, improving all 10 seeds on each corpus at identical parameter storage. Alternis improves five seeds and ties five on AG News; on IMDb its mean gain is near zero. Random returns uniform four-bit in every seed. The tournament representative answers 156 of 400 ARC-Challenge questions correctly versus 163 for uniform; no accuracy gain is demonstrated on this subset. The result favors this tournament variant for text prediction under the tested protocol, not for compression ratio or task accuracy.

papers.title_en: BitShare: Sensitivity-Aware Binning and Bit Sharing for Compacting LLM Weight Storage
papers.authors: Qiuyu Ren, Sudipta Paria, Aritra Dasgupta, Swarup Bhunia
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的敏感度感知比特共享与变精度权重存储
papers.tldr: 小批量解码大语言模型受内存带宽限制，每权重存储位数直接决定开销，而分组整数量化让同组所有通道共享同一精度，忽略通道敏感度差异。BitShare提出无码本权重重格式，保留整数量化网格与反量化器，用敏感度感知分箱将每组通道放入三个固定位置，并通过静态比特共享让低敏感权重共享低位。配合共享感知GPTQ选择存储值，无需微调或码本，提供统一布局的U与逐组布局的N两种模式。2比特下WikiText-2困惑度较SliM-LLM最多降70%、较GPTAQ降35%，同等困惑度下每权重少存13.6%至19.4%比特。
papers.abstract_en: Decoding with large language models at small batch sizes is limited by memory bandwidth, so the bits stored per weight largely set its cost. Group-wise integer quantization stores every weight of a group at the same precision, although the input channels of a group differ in sensitivity. We present BITSHARE, a codebook-free weight format that keeps the integer grid and the dequantizer of group-wise quantization but varies precision within each group. Sensitivity-aware binning places the channels of each group into three bins at fixed positions, and static bit sharing with optimal bit-value allocation lets the less sensitive weights share their lower bits, each stored once per group or once per pair of weights. A sharing-aware version of GPTQ chooses every stored value, with no fine-tuning and no codebook. BITSHARE has two modes. BITSHARE-U gives every group the same layout, so its decoder routes bits by fixed wiring, while BITSHARE-N chooses a layout per group within the same bit budget. With calibration on the Pile and at the same storage, both modes have lower perplexity than GPTQ at 3 and 2 bits on WikiText-2 and C4. At 2 bits across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, BITSHARE-N lowers WikiText-2 perplexity by up to 70% against SliM-LLM and up to 35% against GPTAQ. At the 2-bit perplexity of SliM-LLM, BITSHARE-U stores 13.6-19.4% fewer bits per weight, cutting DRAM weight traffic by the same fraction. A verified hardware decoder implementation synthesized in SkyWater 130 nm reconstructs BITSHARE weights at the throughput of INT-n and SliM-LLM decoders.

papers.title_en: Distilling Touch into Vision-Only Policies for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.authors: Chen Yang, Linhao Wang, Linzhe Shi, Guohui Zhang, Changjie Wu, Hang Zhang, Haoyu Li, Mu Xu, Jiansheng Fan, Chen Wang
papers.evidence: 将触觉引导行为蒸馏到纯视觉操作策略
papers.tldr: 触觉反馈能提升接触丰富操作，但部署触觉传感器增加硬件与维护负担。TacitTouch 将视觉-触觉教师的行为直接蒸馏到纯视觉策略，不再重建触觉观测，而是学习在无触觉时按触觉引导行动。训练中冻结教师在同一噪声动作与流时间上监督学生的去噪预测和中间动作表示，并辅以示范动作监督。在四个仿真与四个真实任务上，它显著优于纯视觉控制，并接近使用实测触觉的教师。
papers.abstract_en: Tactile feedback benefits contact-rich manipulation, yet deploying tactile sensors introduces additional hardware and maintenance requirements. Tactile experience can still provide effective supervision for policies that operate without tactile sensors at deployment. Tactile imagination methods such as TacImag remove this hardware dependency by predicting tactile observations, but retain a reconstruction stage whose errors can propagate into action generation. We present TacitTouch, a distillation framework that transfers tactile-guided behavior directly into a vision-only policy. The core shift is from "learn to imagine what touch would feel like" to "learn to behave as if you could feel touch": the student directly learns tactile-guided action patterns without reconstructing tactile observations. A frozen visuotactile teacher supervises the student's denoising predictions and intermediate action representations at the same noisy action and flow time. Training also uses demonstrated-action supervision. Deployment retains only the visual policy, with no tactile encoder, expert, or generator. Across four simulated UniVTAC tasks and four real-world tasks, TacitTouch achieves absolute improvements of 16.0% and 22.5% in mean success rate over vision-only control, respectively. The absolute gaps to the teacher using measured tactile input are only 2.0% and 3.75%, respectively. In robustness tests, it also outperforms TacImag, with absolute gains of up to 20.0% in mean success rate. Project page: https://pier-lab.github.io/tacittouch/

papers.title_en: VTLA-RL: Learning Visuotactile Policies for Load-Adaptive Grasping
papers.authors: Qiwei Wu, Qixuan Li, Xin Xiang, Xiangyu Chen, Xiang Xiao, Daochen Shi, Ruihua Zhang, Renjing Xu
papers.evidence: 学习用于负载自适应机器人操作的视觉触觉抓取策略
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作模型难以仅凭视觉推断物体质量与局部滑动，变负载抓取需要接触驱动的调整。VTLA-RL 让触觉图像历史与 RGB 共享视觉编码器，在统一动作空间生成运动与双侧力目标。先用真实与仿真混合示范建立运动接触先验，再用两阶段多任务仿真强化学习后训练，并直接部署真机。方法在负载变化与摆放扰动下优于监督初始化，为触觉表征与 RL 后训练路线选择提供实证。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action foundation models learn general manipulation priors, but object mass and local slip are difficult to infer from vision alone. Changing loads require contact-driven grasp adjustments that demonstrations collected under fixed conditions may not adequately cover. We present VTLA-RL to study visuotactile grasping policies and their reinforcement learning (RL) post-training under varying loads. Our main approach shares a visual encoder between tactile-image histories and RGB inputs to jointly generate and execute motion and bilateral force targets in a unified action space. Mixed real and simulated demonstrations first establish motion and contact priors. Two-stage multi-task RL then uses only simulated interaction to optimize the policy through task-success returns without continued real-demonstration supervision, and the trained policy deploys directly to real robots. We compare tactile representations and RL post-training routes in simulation and separately evaluate load variation and placement perturbations on hardware. The full method achieves higher grasping success than the supervised initialization, while RL post-training gains differ across approaches, providing empirical evidence for choosing representations and training approaches for this task.

papers.title_en: A Glimpse of Training VLMs as Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Meng-Hao Guo, Yi Zhang, Zhe-Han Mo, Han-Zheng Wang, Jia-Jun Wang, Xin-Sheng Chen, Jiaxi Song, Yi-Xuan Deng, Jia-Ning Li, Xuanyu Chu, Hengrui Zhang, Huan-ang Gao, Yongming Rao, Shi-Min Hu
papers.evidence: 训练视觉语言模型作为机器人操作基础模型
papers.tldr: GPT-6 Astra在机器人控制上展现强泛化，但训练细节未公开，如何复现成为问题。nanoAstra将机器人行为表示为语义步骤与可复用参数化动作原语，并结合能力保持的CP-SFT训练VLM。在RoboTwin 2.0随机基准上，9B模型零样本成功率达17.8%，优于先进VLA/WAM与同规模VLM。其流式执行将机器人空闲时间从35.0%降至6.9%。
papers.abstract_en: Recently, GPT-6 Astra demonstrates strong generalization in robot control, yet limited disclosure of its training leaves open how such capabilities can be reproduced. We introduce nanoAstra, an approach to training vision-language models (VLMs) for generalizable manipulation that combines semantic action modeling with capability-preserving supervised fine-tuning (CP-SFT). nanoAstra represents robot behavior as semantic steps composed of reusable, parameterized action primitives, guided by explicit progress descriptions. Meanwhile, CP-SFT uses an explicit robot-specific system prompt to constrain manipulation outputs to a structured action space, aiming to focus adaptation on robot-specific contexts and promote specialization while minimizing interference with broader pretrained capabilities. With this formulation, we train nanoAstra on more than 5,000 hours of robot data together with general VQA data. On RoboTwin 2.0's randomized benchmark, nanoAstra-9B achieves a 17.8% zero-shot success rate, substantially outperforming advanced VLA and WAM baselines as well as similarly sized VLMs. With inference faster than the corresponding motion execution on a single H20 GPU, our model supports action-chunk-like streaming execution that overlaps inference with motion, reducing the robot's idle time from 35.0% to 6.9%.

papers.title_en: Quantizing in the Loop: Drift-Aware Ultra-Low-Bit Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Yanlong Chen, Thongthornpatch Chamadol, Yichen Guo, Yunfei Gao, Mohan Liu, Addison Lin Wang, Yawei Li
papers.evidence: 面向视觉-语言-动作模型的超低比特训练后量化
papers.tldr: 超低比特量化视觉-语言-动作模型在≤2比特时常崩溃，根源是离线校准分布漂移与逐层重构目标错位。LoopQ改用量化策略自身rollout状态做在线校准，并冻结trellis码，仅微调查找表与缩放因子以对齐动作头读出的全精度教师。2比特线性层下，GR00T N1.7在LIBERO-Plus达60.4%，接近全精度61.8%；1比特π0.5仍完成80.0% LIBERO任务。方法在Jetson AGX Thor和真实机械臂上验证了部署可行性，为超低比特VLA提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large vision-language-action (VLA) models on resource-constrained robots demands extreme compression, yet existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods frequently collapse at ultra-low bit-widths ($\le$ 2 bits). We trace this failure to two mismatches in standard pipelines. First, calibrating on static offline demonstrations induces distribution shift: minor quantization perturbations drive the policy into unseen states where uncalibrated errors compound. Second, minimizing the layer-wise weight reconstruction error is a flawed proxy, as action generation depends only on the representations consumed by the action head. We present LoopQ, an on-policy ultra-low-bit quantization framework. LoopQ closes the loop by calibrating on states from the quantized policy's own rollouts. It then adds readout-aligned fine-tuning, which freezes the trellis codes and optimizes only lightweight lookup tables and scaling factors to align the backbone readout with the full-precision teacher. With all linear layers at 2 bits, LoopQ achieves a 60.4% success rate on LIBERO-Plus with GR00T N1.7, close to the 61.8% of full precision. Even at 1 bit per weight, $π_{0.5}$ still completes 80.0% of LIBERO tasks. With 8-bit activations, the 2-bit $π_{0.5}$ runs on integer kernels on an embedded NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor, with 4.1$\times$ smaller weights and 44% less memory. On a real AgileX Piper arm, it stays within one success of full precision on each of three tasks. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/LoopQ

papers.title_en: JEPA-ICL: Progress-Aligned Latent Plans for In-Context Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Tingjun Dai, Jianxiang He, Mingfei Han, Qihao Yu, Longtao Jiang, Changlin Li, Minghao Jin, Zhihui Li, Xiaojun Chang
papers.evidence: 耦合隐空间规划与示教学习的视觉-语言-动作框架
papers.tldr: 机器人演示因具身、外观和执行速度差异难以对齐当前进度，现有方法难定位相关示范。JEPA-ICL将预测规划与示范学习耦合：在JEPA特征空间预测子任务完成前的有序未来状态，并用其定位示范中进度对齐内容。该上下文反哺共享策略，连接自身执行预判与经验复用。实验在Imitator Game达80.0%，LIBERO-Plus提升至75.2%，表明进度对齐的潜在规划能提升跨任务示范复用。
papers.abstract_en: Demonstrations show how a task can be completed, but differences in embodiment, appearance, and execution speed make it difficult to identify the guidance relevant to the robot's current progress. We introduce JEPA-ICL, a vision-language-action framework that couples predictive planning with demonstration learning. The policy learns to plan by predicting ordered future states in JEPA feature space up to subtask completion, capturing what remains to be accomplished. These plans guide action generation and locate relevant stages in demonstrations, whose JEPA-supervised content features provide progress-aligned context. Learning from this context, in turn, updates the shared policy that produces the plans and actions. This coupling connects anticipating the robot's own execution with reusing demonstrated experience. On the Imitator Game, JEPA-ICL achieves 80.0% seen-task success under C15 pretraining, outperforming Zero-WAM by 12.0 percentage points. Without contextual demonstrations, JEPA-ICL outperforms the VLA-JEPA variant without human-video pretraining, improving success rates from 96.1% to 97.6% on LIBERO and from 62.9% to 73.2% on LIBERO-Plus. With demonstration-based training and contextual guidance at inference, LIBERO-Plus success further increases from 73.2% to 75.2%.

papers.title_en: Quantizing Diffusion LLMs under Parallel Decoding: Commitment Risk and the Parallelism Tax
papers.authors: Huan Xu, Maosen Zhao, Pengtao Chen, Tao Chen
papers.evidence: 在部署的并行解码器下对扩散大模型做W4A4训练后量化
papers.tldr: 扩散大语言模型常以带缓存、阈值提交的加速解码器部署，但 W4A4 量化此前多在固定步数采样下校准评估。本文在实际解码器下发现，量化误差主要来自无位置过阈值的强制提交，且压缩 logit 差距会带来额外前向的并行税。DECAL 用提交风险先验重加权逐层校准，并以保持 argmax 的提交温度补偿并行税。在 LLaDA 与 Dream 上取得 W4A4 方法最佳平均精度，且运行间方差更低。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are served with accelerated decoders that cache context and commit, in one step, every masked position whose confidence clears a threshold. Yet post-training quantization of dLLMs has so far been calibrated and evaluated under fixed-step samplers without caching. We study W4A4 quantization under the deployed decoder and find that the decoder determines both where quantization harms accuracy and what it costs. Irreversible errors enter chiefly through forced commitments, made when no position clears the threshold: they are a minority of commitments but carry most quantization-induced flips. Quantization also levies a parallelism tax, extra forward passes per response: by compressing top logit gaps, it pushes positions below the threshold while leaving predictions largely intact. We propose DECAL, which reweights layer-wise calibration by a commitment-risk prior measured on the deployed decoder, and an argmax-preserving commit temperature that recovers the tax. On LLaDA and Dream, DECAL attains the best average accuracy among W4A4 methods, with lower run-to-run variance than the closest existing calibration method.

papers.title_en: Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression
papers.authors: Anindya Roy Chowdhury, Atanu Barai, Nandakishore Santhi
papers.evidence: 无需训练、渐进残差符号量化的Transformer权重压缩
papers.tldr: 低比特量化虽降低存储，却常损害 Transformer 的预测保真度。本文提出免训练、免经验CDF的渐进残差符号量化框架：用随机正交混合使残差更接近高斯分布，并在每个阶段独立归一化残差、解析校准重建，无需学习码本或网格优化。在 GPT-2 Large 与 Llama-3-8B 上，五阶段联合量化困惑度为32.16和12.73，接近全精度29.89和11.07。消融显示正交混合优于恒等符号编码，激活感知缩放提升输出保真度，降低精度统计可减少存储开销且困惑度退化可忽略。
papers.abstract_en: LLM quantization reduces storage but often degrades predictive fidelity at low bit rates. We propose a training-free, CDF-free, Gaussian-CLT-motivated progressive residual-sign quantization framework that uses randomized orthogonal mixing to promote Gaussian-like residual distributions and improve sign based reconstruction of Transformer weights. Each stage independently normalizes residuals and analytically calibrates reconstruction, progressively recovering quantization errors. The framework enables flexible storage-fidelity trade-offs without learned codebooks, empirical CDFs, or trellis optimization. We evaluate GPT-2 Large and Llama-3-8B across attention and MLP projections. At five residual stages, joint quantization preserves near-baseline predictive fidelity, achieving perplexities of 32.16 and 12.73, compared with full-precision values of 29.89 and 11.07, respectively. Ablations further demonstrate that orthogonal mixing substantially improves reconstruction over identity-based sign coding, while activation-aware scaling improves output fidelity and reduced-precision statistics lower storage overhead with negligible perplexity degradation. Comparisons with conventional quantizers establish the method's progressive fidelity recovery and characterize its storage-quality and runtime trade-offs. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of orthogonally mixed residual-sign coding for flexible, training-free Transformer weight compression.

papers.title_en: EgoLAM: Learning Latent Actions from Hand and Head Motion
papers.authors: Ziyi Ding, Yiwei Wang, Zhongxing Wei, Xianxin Lai, Yechi Liu, Xiaodi Huang, Jinghua Hou, Xiaoquan Sun, Haijier Chen, Zhe Liu, Yinan Chen, Junqiao Zhao, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Jiayu Chen
papers.evidence: 从第一视角视频学习潜在动作模型，分离手腕运动与相机运动以学习操作策略
papers.tldr: 第一人称视频中，杯子在画面里移动可能来自手推动，也可能来自佩戴者转头，但只有前者是操作行为。EgoLAM在训练时用实测手腕运动监督动作编码，并把相机运动单独输入前向模型，使动作码只描述手如何推动物体。其动作编码器汇聚每只手周围的对象槽，可从两帧RGB中解出同一参考系下的手腕平移与旋转。评测中，其手部运动解码得分在八个模型中最高；在三个LIBERO套件上，策略平均成功率达79.38%，比专家行为克隆高28.73分，比最强其他潜动作模型平均高9.76分。
papers.abstract_en: Latent action models let a robot policy learn from video by turning the change between two frames into a training target. In egocentric video, a cup can move across the image because a hand pushes it or because the wearer turns. Both changes help predict the next frame, but only the first describes manipulation. During training, EgoLAM supervises the action code with measured wrist motion and supplies camera motion separately to the forward model. Even when the wearer turns while pushing a cup, the training target still describes how the hand pushed it. The action encoder pools object slots around each hand, and wrist translation and rotation can be decoded from the code in a common reference frame. Extracting a code then requires only two RGB frames. Alongside LARYBench classification and regression, we measure how much wrist motion a frozen code retains and how strongly it responds to a synthetic view or lighting change. EgoLAM has the highest hand-motion decoding score among eight evaluated models. Across three LIBERO suites, policies pretrained on its codes and fine-tuned on expert demonstrations achieve 79.38% mean success, 28.73 points above expert behavior cloning and 9.76 points above the strongest other latent action model in each suite on average.

papers.title_en: GenPA: Image Generators as Efficient Robot Policies
papers.authors: Zian Deng, Tianyi Zhang, Zilong Zheng, Ziyu Liu, Tao Zhang, Yao Lyu, Shengbo Eben Li
papers.evidence: 将图像生成模型改造为机器人操作策略
papers.tldr: 现有视觉生成机器人策略仍将未来视觉预测作为训练核心，推理时也常保留该目标。GenPA直接把图像生成骨干适配为动作学习器，仅用19M参数动作回归适配器微调，并复用原生生成目标做感知共训练。在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上分别达到99.10%和83.79%成功率，真实任务表现稳健；单张H100编译推理下每个动作块仅20.9ms，较强VLA/WAM基线快1.7-3.4倍。部署无需视觉生成或迭代去噪，消融显示当前深度监督是简单有效的训练配方。
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained visual generation models have shown great promise in robotic manipulation. However, a representative line of work still treats future visual prediction as the central link between visual generative pretraining and action learning, retaining it as a training objective even when future scenes are no longer generated at inference time. We argue that the instruction-following, spatial understanding, and visual imagination capabilities acquired through image generation pretraining can support control without future visual prediction: image generation models themselves can be directly adapted into powerful action learners. Building on this perspective, we propose GenPA, which fine-tunes an image generation backbone with a lightweight 19M-parameter action regression adapter and reuses its native generative objective for perception co-training. The native image-editing interface accommodates different visual targets without task-specific perception heads, enabling comparisons of current-scene perception, future prediction, and their combinations within a common policy architecture. At deployment, GenPA requires only a single backbone forward pass and action regression, without visual generation or iterative action denoising. Without additional large-scale robot-data pretraining, GenPA demonstrates strong control performance and robustness to perturbations across simulation benchmarks (99.10% success on LIBERO and 83.79% on LIBERO-Plus) and real-world manipulation tasks. Under compiled inference, GenPA takes 20.9 ms per action chunk on a single H100 GPU, achieving 1.7-3.4x speedups over strong VLA and WAM baselines. Our latency analysis further highlights architectural advantages of visual generation backbones for efficient robot control. Ablations across visual tasks and their combinations identify current-depth supervision as a simple, effective training recipe.

papers.title_en: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Zhenxuan Fan, Zhuoya Wang, Yuqian Yuan, Wenqiao Zhang, Juncheng Li, Jun Xiao, Siliang Tang, Yueting Zhuang
papers.evidence: 基于视觉语言模型的双智能体机器人操作决策框架
papers.tldr: 针对VLM机器人智能体记忆组织不足、失败归因不清与执行经验难复用的问题，提出双智能体框架Embodied-Harness，在不更新模型参数的前提下迭代优化执行工具链。Actor通过机器人控制接口与环境交互，Reflector将执行证据转化为可复用操作指南，并结合分层记忆与证据驱动反思实现递归自我改进。在RoboTwin 2.0、RoboSPA与RMBench上分别达到82.4%、76.7%、94.4%成功率，真实三任务平均96.7%。结果表明经验驱动的执行工具链自改进可提升泛化、空间推理、长程规划与记忆依赖操作。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters. The Actor interacts with the environment through a robot-control interface, while the Reflector converts execution evidence into reusable operational guidance. Hierarchical Memory Architecture maintains short-term execution context and long-term experiential knowledge to support execution and reflection. Evidence-based Experience Reflection grounds failure diagnosis in observed interactions, while Recursive Harness Self-Improvement refines operational guidance across successive attempts. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Embodied-Harness in generalization under environmental variations, spatial reasoning, long-horizon planning, and memory-dependent manipulation. Our method achieves success rates of 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% on the three benchmarks, respectively. Real-world evaluation further yields an average success rate of 96.7% across three manipulation tasks. These results highlight the potential of Embodied-Harness to improve robotic manipulation through experience-driven harness self-improvement.

papers.title_en: Intervention-Robust VLA: Diverse Demonstrations for Robot Deployment with Safety Filters
papers.authors: Tzu-Yuan Huang, Shao-Hsuan Chang, Dai-Jie Wu, Ralf Römer, Yung-Hui Li, Stefan Sosnowski, Angela P. Schoellig, Kenneth Marino, Sandra Hirche
papers.evidence: 面向安全部署的干预鲁棒视觉-语言-动作模型
papers.tldr: VLA能从示范学习复杂机器人行为，但真实场景难以覆盖安全关键状态；测试时安全过滤器虽可纠正动作，却会把机器人带入训练分布外，削弱任务表现。InteR-VLA利用多样化完成任务示范扩大任务相关状态覆盖，在相同数据预算下对齐训练分布与安全过滤部署，缓解干预诱导的分布偏移。真实实验在分布内与分布外设置均保持安全，Safe Success Rate从0%最高提升至90%，并在两个VLA上稳定优于常规数据训练。该工作提升了安全干预下的部署鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have shown strong potential for learning complex robotic behaviors from demonstrations. However, learning safe behavior directly from data requires extensive coverage of safety-critical situations, which is often impractical in real-world settings. Test-time safety filters provide an alternative by correcting unsafe actions during deployment, but these interventions can drive the robot into states poorly covered by the training data, thereby degrading task performance. We introduce InteR-VLA, an intervention-robust framework for VLAs that leverages diverse task-completing demonstrations to broaden task-relevant state coverage and maintain competence under safety interventions. By better aligning the training distribution with safety-filtered deployment under the same data budget, our approach mitigates intervention-induced distribution shift while preserving task performance. Real-world experiments across in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings show that InteR-VLA maintains safety, increases Safe Success Rate up to 90% from 0% for nominal policies, and consistently outperforms nominal-data training on both evaluated VLAs.

papers.title_en: Probing Invisible Actuation Shifts for Test-time Calibration of Visuomotor Policies
papers.authors: Jie Liu, Hui Xie, Qinfeng Feng, Joaquin Vanschoren
papers.evidence: 视觉-语言-动作等视动策略在执行偏移下的测试时校准
papers.tldr: 视觉运动策略部署时常遇到相机或控制器变化：视觉偏移可见，而执行偏移（增益、延迟、负载）对策略不可见并显著降低成功率。PEA在每回合前用已知指令逐轴短探测，闭式辨识执行偏移并补偿后续动作，无需训练策略。结合可移除低秩适配器应对视觉与执行耦合偏移。在LIBERO上，PEA将Cosmos-Policy在LIBERO-Spatial的成功率从61.0%提升到89.7%，并泛化到未见偏移。
papers.abstract_en: Visuomotor policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world action models (WAMs) are increasingly deployed on robots whose cameras and controllers differ from those used to collect their training data. Such deployment introduces two kinds of shifts. Visual shifts, such as a moved camera, change the observed images; actuation shifts, such as a retuned controller, latency or an added payload, change only how commanded actions translate into robot motion. Invisible to the policy, actuation shifts sharply degrade its success, even under domain randomization. In this work, we propose PEA, a test-time calibration method that identifies actuation shifts through active probing before task execution. Specifically, before each episode, the robot executes a short probe that moves one arm axis at a time with known commands, so that gain, delay and drift leave separable traces. A closed-form identifier estimates them from the response, and PEA compensates every subsequent command so that the robot executes the motion the policy intends. The identifier requires no policy training and thus applies to any frozen visuomotor policy. Since visual shifts remain visible to the policy, PEA further adapts the frozen policy with a removable low-rank adapter, addressing coupled visual and actuation shifts. Experiments on LIBERO with a WAM and a VLA show that, without any policy training, the identifier of PEA recovers most of the success lost to actuation shifts and generalizes to shifts unseen during training (e.g., from 61.0% to 89.7% on LIBERO-Spatial with Cosmos-Policy).

papers.title_en: Fast World Planner: Advantage-Aware Action-Chunk Policy for Online Planning
papers.authors: Jiangtao Kong, Yuchen Wang, Yandong Luo, Rongchao Xu, Guang Wang, Yanbing Mao, Lu Gan, Tianyi Zhou, Huajie Shao
papers.evidence: 为在线MPPI控制规划学习优势感知动作块策略
papers.tldr: MPPI在线规划依赖迭代细化，降低迭代会损害性能。SWAN以k-MPPI与MFA动作块策略表示完整H步规划提案，并用优势引导提案优化复用MPPI评估构建更优目标。在31个高维连续控制任务上，SWAN以少50%的MPPI细化迭代提升性能与样本效率，并实现Unitree Go2零样本sim-to-real。
papers.abstract_en: Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is central to online planning for model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL), but its iterative refinement incurs planning latency. Reducing refinement iterations often degrades performance, motivating stronger policy guidance learned from the planner. However, existing methods typically learn from the planner through action-level alignment, which does not directly capture the complete $H$-step planner proposal. Moreover, planner imitation leaves further target improvement to online refinement. To address these limitations, we propose FaSt World PlANner (SWAN), an advantage-aware MPPI-based MBRL framework that explicitly represents and improves the complete $H$-step planner proposal to improve policy guidance for efficient online planning. For proposal representation, SWAN combines k-MPPI, a multimodal MPPI extension, with a mixture of factor analyzers (MFA) action-chunk policy to capture multiple modes and correlations across time and action dimensions. For proposal optimization, we introduce Advantage-Guided Proposal Optimization (APO), which reuses MPPI evaluations to construct an improved target using advantage estimates and trains the policy toward this target while preserving planner alignment. Experiments across 31 high-dimensional continuous-control tasks from DMControl, HumanoidBench, and MyoSuite show that SWAN substantially improves control performance and sample efficiency while using 50% fewer MPPI refinement iterations than state-of-the-art planning-based MBRL methods. Finally, SWAN demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a physical Unitree Go2, achieving stable velocity-tracking locomotion with high-frequency control. (see our demo at https://swanfastworldplanner.github.io/)

papers.title_en: DeRail: Escaping Trajectory Priors via Counterfactual Action Steering for Mid-Execution Instruction Switching
papers.authors: Yitong Hong, Xiangdong Feng, Xiaoxi Sun, Senqiao Yang, Boyao Han, Zhejian Yang, Shiyang Zhou, Yongcai Wang, Pengguang Chen, Shu Liu, Li Jiang, Zhuotao Tian
papers.evidence: 面向指令条件VLA机器人策略的免训练推理时引导
papers.tldr: 机器人执行中常遇指令切换，但现有VLA与WAM策略多在固定指令下评测，切换后易出现轨迹劫持。作者提出免训练、模型无关的推理时反事实动作引导CAS：识别干扰任务，查询同一策略的反事实指令，用目标与反事实动作差修正执行。在多个切换基准与真实机器人上，CAS显著提升切换成功率，如CALVIN区间将π0.5从5.8%提至54.6%。其成功轨迹还能作为更优自训练监督，增强对后续未见切换的泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating in the real world must often adapt when user instructions change mid-execution, yet current instruction-conditioned robot policies, including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World-Action Models (WAMs), are largely evaluated under fixed-instruction episodes. We study mid-execution instruction switching and identify trajectory hijacking as a key failure mode, where the policy fails to redirect sufficiently toward the switched target, with its post-switch behavior remaining fully or partially drawn toward trajectories associated with non-target tasks. We propose Counterfactual Action Steering (CAS), a training-free, model-agnostic inference-time method that identifies interfering non-target tasks, queries the same policy with corresponding counterfactual instructions, and uses target--counterfactual action differences to steer execution away from interfering trajectory priors. Experiments on LIBERO-Goal-Switch and CALVIN-Custom-Switch across five VLA and WAM policies, together with real-robot evaluation, show that CAS consistently improves switching success; for example, on CALVIN-Custom-Switch in the $[15,21]$ switching range, CAS improves $π_{0.5}$ from 5.8\% to 54.6\%. Successful CAS-guided rollouts further provide higher-quality self-training supervision than vanilla successful rollouts with the same number of trajectories, yielding stronger policies that generalize to unseen later instruction switches. Code will be made publicly available.

papers.title_en: NAT: Scaling Causal Neural Action Tokenizers Across Embodiments
papers.authors: Ahad Jawaid, Alexander Swerdlow, Yu Xiang
papers.evidence: 面向跨本体视觉-语言-动作机器人策略的动作分词器
papers.tldr: 动作分词器让机器人策略以自回归下一词预测处理控制，但跨本体通用分词仍难。作者用4.9万小时多源动作数据训练因果神经动作分词器NAT，其解码器可在生成token时执行动作。四个仿真基准上，NAT对未见本体的分词优于FAST和先前神经分词器；用于VLA时在四个基准及真实机器人上超过FAST+，部分基准接近flow-matching动作头并降低首动作延迟。仅用人类手部运动训练的NAT也接近机器人数据训练结果，表明通用动作空间未必依赖机器人数据。
papers.abstract_en: Action tokenizers let robot policies treat control as autoregressive next-token prediction. As these policies are trained on larger and more diverse datasets, they will need a universal tokenizer that can encode actions from many embodiments and data sources, including ones it has not seen. We study action tokenization at scale, training on 49k hours of action data from real-world robots, handheld grippers, simulation, and humans. We introduce Neural Action Tokenizer (NAT), a causal tokenizer whose decoder lets actions be executed as their tokens are generated. Across four simulation benchmarks, NAT outperforms FAST and prior neural action tokenizers when tokenizing unseen robot embodiments, and in vision-language-action models it outperforms FAST+ across four benchmarks and on a real robot when acting through its tokens. NAT tokens also close the performance gap to a flow-matching action head on some benchmarks while lowering the inference latency for first actions. Our experiments also find that robot data may not be necessary to learn an effective action space: a NAT trained only on human hand motion performs close to tokenizers trained on robot data.

papers.title_en: FlowPAC: Flow-Guided Visual Pruning and Action Caching for Efficient VLA Inference
papers.authors: Jintao Cheng, Yipu Zhang, Haozhe Wang, Lin Jiang, Jiang Xu, Wei Zhang
papers.evidence: 通过视觉token剪枝与动作缓存实现VLA高效推理
papers.tldr: VLA模型推理延迟和内存开销高，现有免训练加速依赖静态资源分配，难以匹配动态机器人交互。FlowPAC以任务感知光流为共享物理信号，联合优化视觉token与动作计算，提出DATP、LACT和FCAR。在LIBERO闭环评测中，30%视觉token保留下成功率基本保持，端到端加速2.13倍。结果表明按物理动态与硬件约束分配计算，可提升边缘VLA部署效率。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied AI, yet their high inference latency and memory footprint remain major barriers to edge deployment. Existing training-free acceleration techniques, such as visual token pruning and action caching, typically rely on static resource allocation. This mismatch with dynamic robotic interactions not only degrades control performance but also causes severe hardware inefficiencies, including fragmented KV-cache layouts and wasted compute on non-critical regions. To address this, we propose FlowPAC, a locality-aware framework that leverages task-aware optical flow as a shared physical signal to jointly optimize visual and action computation. Specifically, we introduce Direction-Aware Trajectory Propagation (DATP) and Locality-Aware Contiguous Token Selection (LACT) to jointly handle visual token dynamics and enforce spatial locality, reducing memory fragmentation and enabling efficient KV-cache compression. This is complemented by Flow-Conditioned Action-Block Refresh (FCAR) for adaptive action computation based on motion dynamics. Extensive closed-loop evaluations on LIBERO demonstrate that FlowPAC achieves a 2.13$\times$ end-to-end speedup over the dense baseline while essentially maintaining the success rate with 30% visual-token retention. These results validate that aligning computation allocation with both physical dynamics and hardware constraints is essential for efficient VLA deployment on edge systems.

papers.title_en: Defending Vision-Language-Action Models against Transferable Attacks via Visual-Proprioceptive Consistency
papers.authors: Jiahao Wang, Ming F. Li, Han Xu
papers.evidence: 面向机器人任务的视觉-语言-动作模型防御
papers.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人任务中表现优异，但其对抗攻击可跨任务迁移，严重威胁机器人系统安全。本文观察到各类可迁移攻击都会扰乱模型对机器人自身位置的感知，据此提出以本体感受为可信基准的防御框架，将本体状态构建的空间参考与视觉推断的机器人位置比对，以两者差异作为攻击检测信号。实验表明该方法能有效检测可迁移对抗补丁并提升闭环性能，真机实验也验证了其有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in a wide range of robotic tasks. However, adversarial attacks in VLA models have shown strong transferability across robotic tasks, posing significant threats to robotic systems. Despite their different attack strategies, we observe that these transferable attacks share a common consequence: they disrupt the VLA model's perception towards the robot itself. Motivated by this observation, we propose a proprioception-grounded defense framework that leverages trusted proprioceptive information to detect and mitigate transferable adversarial attacks. Specifically, we utilize the robot's proprioceptive states to establish a trusted spatial reference, and compare it with the robot's perceived location inferred from visual features. Discrepancies between these two sources provide a reliable signal for detecting adversarial attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate effective detection of transferable adversarial patches and improved closed-loop performance. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of our defense on real-world robotic tasks.

papers.title_en: NavDecision: Parallel Multi-Step Action Prediction with Persistent Self-Referential Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Kai Wu, Yufan Hu, Quan Fang, Boning Zhang, Junyu Gao
papers.evidence: 从视觉-语言状态预测动作分布用于导航决策
papers.tldr: 视觉语言导航需及时决策，但自回归模型逐词生成动作描述，推理开销大。NavDecision以并行多步动作预测从共享视觉语言状态输出多个动作分布，并用记忆增强自参考策略优化学习失败轨迹。4B骨干在R2R-CE与RxR-CE成功率约64.6%，推理最高加速22.28倍和18.96倍。该工作兼顾多步决策一致性与长程目标对齐，提升VLN决策效率。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires timely decisions based on instructions and visual observations. However, autoregressive VLN models generate action descriptions token by token, introducing substantial inference overhead. Decision models offer an efficient alternative but face challenges in maintaining short-horizon action coherence and long-horizon goal alignment. To address these challenges, we propose NavDecision, an efficient multi-step VLN decision model. We introduce parallel multi-step action prediction (PMAP) to predict multiple action distributions from a shared vision-language state, and memory-augmented self-referential policy optimization (M-SRPO) to learn from unsuccessful trajectories using successful trajectories as references. A cross-iteration success memory further accumulates historical successful trajectories to provide informative training feedback. NavDecision achieves success rates of 64.60% on R2R-CE and 64.57% on RxR-CE with a 4B backbone. Compared with existing autoregressive VLN methods, it delivers significant inference speedups of up to $22.28\times$ and $18.96\times$ while maintaining comparable navigation performance.

papers.title_en: LIBERO-MOR: A Multimodal Robustness Benchmark Across the Vision-Language-Action Pipeline
papers.authors: Qihang Chen, Tengjie Li, Hongwei Lu, Jason Wu, Chyna Qu, Shikui Tu, Lei Xu
papers.evidence: 面向机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作全流程鲁棒性基准
papers.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操作基准上表现亮眼，但部署时对交互链路扰动的鲁棒性缺乏系统评估。本文提出 LIBERO-MOR，基于 LIBERO 覆盖视觉、语言、本体感知、动作执行与环境五类域，设计22种部署扰动、三级严重度与40任务配对评测。实验评估七类代表性VLA模型，发现高清洁成功率背后存在显著鲁棒性缺口及共享与模型特有失效模式。该基准将总体性能关联到管线域、单项扰动与干预强度，为诊断VLA鲁棒性提供系统框架。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance on robot manipulation benchmarks. Translating this progress into reliable deployment calls for systematic evaluation of how policies respond to variations throughout the robot interaction loop. We introduce LIBERO-MOR, a multimodal robustness benchmark across the vision-language-action pipeline. Built on standard LIBERO, it covers five deployment-facing domains: vision, language, proprioception, action execution, and environment. The benchmark comprises 22 deployment-inspired perturbations, each evaluated at three severity levels across 40 tasks under a paired clean-perturbed protocol, enabling controlled and reproducible comparisons. We evaluate seven representative VLA models spanning diverse action-generation mechanisms. Our experiments reveal substantial robustness gaps behind high clean-task success, together with shared vulnerabilities and distinct model-specific failure patterns across domains. Severity analysis further distinguishes progressive degradation, collapse at stronger interventions, and failures triggered at the mildest tested level. By connecting aggregate performance to pipeline domains, individual perturbations, and intervention strength, LIBERO-MOR provides a systematic framework for diagnosing VLA robustness and guiding the development of more reliable robot policies.
